goldens.comment: The logic for checking team admin/owner permissions is incorrect. This condition uses AND (&&) which requires both isTeamAdmin AND isTeamOwner to be true, but it should use OR (||) since a user needs to be either an admin OR an owner to have permission.

candidates: Authorization logic bug: the variable `isTeamAdminOrOwner` joins `isTeamAdmin()` and `isTeamOwner()` with a logical AND (`&&`) instead of OR (`||`), requiring a user to be both a team admin and a team owner simultaneously, effectively denying access to users who hold only one of those roles

Wrong email type sent to existing attendees: `sendAddGuestsEmails` receives the raw `guests` input instead of `uniqueGuests`, causing existing attendees whose email appeared in the original input to incorrectly receive a full booking confirmation email (`AttendeeScheduledEmail`) instead of a guest-added notification (`AttendeeAddGuestsEmail`)
